result.summary: Two minor visual issues related to data redundancy and interface consistency were identified.

issues.description: Redundant delivery fee information is displayed on larger restaurant cards, appearing both as a badge on the image and in the text description.
issues.suggestion: Consolidate the delivery fee information into a single location to reduce visual clutter and improve readability.

issues.description: There is a lack of feature parity between list sections; the 'Popular right now' cards include favorite icons while the 'Fastest near you' cards do not.
issues.suggestion: Standardize UI elements, such as the favorite heart icon, across all restaurant card variants for a more cohesive experience.
